nodes.title: duplex research 2026-10-11 (docs/research/duplex-2026-10/LANDSCAPE.md, primary sources read today): Azure Voice Live supports hi-IN (multilingual input model, azure_semantic_vad_multilingual, MAI-Transcribe-2, hi-IN voices) and has server AEC with a Live-Reference mode for client playback, deep noise suppression and semantic end of turn. It is half-duplex with barge-in, and its filler-word false-barge-in filter is English-only. gpt-realtime and gpt-realtime-mini list Hindi; gpt-realtime-2.1(-regional) is deployable through Voice Live in centralindia. GPT-Live-1 is the only full-duplex model sold Direct on Azure ($3/h); on IndicFDB Hindi it replies in 0.18 s but takes the floor in ~38% of natural pauses. No open full-duplex model has usable Hindi with commercial weights (PersonaPlex and Moshi are English; Human-1 Hindi Moshi has no confirmed weights and 0.56/5 on interruption replies). CPU-runnable turn models today: Smart Turn v3 (BSD-2, Hindi 93.4% on its own test set)

PersonaPlex-7B teardown 2026-10-11 (docs/research/duplex-2026-10/PERSONAPLEX.md): English-only (model card en; the Moshi tokenizer has no Devanagari). Code MIT; weights under the NVIDIA Open Model License (commercial OK, revocable, guardrail-circumvention termination). ~17 GB bf16 plus ~1.6 GB KV per session. Central India SKUs: NC24ads A100 v4 $5.14/h, NC40ads H100 v5 $9.77/h (Retail Prices API, ESTIMATE); no Container Apps serverless A100 in India. The reference server runs one session per process. A Hindi path starts from Human-1 plus PersonaPlex's prompt recipe; data, not compute, is the blocker. The inner-monologue text arrives with its audio, so a text safety predicate can only mute after the first syllable unless a hold buffer adds latency

duplex research: ideas to adopt in our own engine without hosting a duplex model (PERSONAPLEX.md §5): (1) a small 80 ms frame turn / voice-activity-projection model trained on two-channel labels; (2) her own stream as an input (playback cross-correlation, VAD on the AEC residual, TTS word clock); (3) an Azure-only Hinglish synthetic dialogue factory with stitched turns, overlaps and echo; (4) a backchannel head with pre-rendered haan / achha capped near the human rate; (5) tutor role and safety probes in TaxilaFDB. The owner's no-new-features decision of 2026-10-10 holds until main says otherwise
